name: Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms (RJSC)
service: Name clearance, company and partnership registration, and annual return filing.
process: Online through the RJSC portal, with fees paid to a designated bank.
applicationPath: Start at roc.gov.bd. Use the bare domain — the www subdomain does not resolve.
notes: The first stop for a limited company or registered partnership. The portal has been intermittently unreachable in the past — if it is down, try again rather than assuming your entity type is unsupported.

name: BIDA One Stop Service
service: Consolidated investor services for registration and post-registration approvals.
process: Online through the BIDA OSS portal.
notes: Aimed at investors, including foreign ones, rather than at every small local business. Check which of your approvals are actually routed through OSS before relying on it.

name: National Board of Revenue – e-TIN and income tax
service: TIN registration and income tax return filing.
process: Online registration and e-return through the NBR taxpayer portal.
ministry: Internal Resources Division, Ministry of Finance
applicationPath: Register for a TIN at etaxnbr.gov.bd.
notes: A TIN is needed early — a trade licence and a company bank account both depend on it.

name: National Board of Revenue – VAT Online (BIN)
service: VAT registration or turnover-tax enlistment (BIN) and Mushak return filing.
process: Online through the VAT Online portal.
ministry: Internal Resources Division, Ministry of Finance
applicationPath: Apply for a BIN at vat.gov.bd.
notes: Registration and enlistment are different things with different thresholds. Read NBR's own guidance before choosing which one you apply for.

name: Dhaka North City Corporation – trade licence
service: Trade licence issue and annual renewal for businesses inside the DNCC area.
process: Application at the ward or regional office, with the fee set by the city corporation tax schedule.
applicationPath: Follow the trade licence procedure page on dncc.gov.bd.
notes: Which corporation you apply to depends on your business address, not your home address. Fees vary by trade category.

name: Dhaka South City Corporation – trade licence
service: Trade licence issue and annual renewal for businesses inside the DSCC area.
process: Application at the ward or regional office, with the fee set by the city corporation tax schedule.
applicationPath: Follow the trade licence procedure page on dscc.gov.bd.
notes: Outside the two Dhaka corporations, the equivalent office is your own city corporation, pourashava or union parishad.

name: Chief Controller of Imports and Exports (CCIE)
service: Import Registration Certificate (IRC) and Export Registration Certificate (ERC).
process: Application through the CCIE office and portal.
notes: Needed before you can legally import or export commercially. Physical goods only — not required to sell software abroad.

name: Export Promotion Bureau (EPB)
service: Export facilitation, registration and export-related certification.
process: Through the EPB portal and its offices.
notes: Relevant once you are exporting rather than at registration time.

name: Department of Environment (DOE)
service: Environmental clearance certificate, by industry category.
process: Category-based application through DOE divisional and district offices.
ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
applicationPath: Start at doe.gov.bd and identify your category first.
notes: Which category you fall in decides how heavy the process is. Manufacturing and food processing usually need this; a software business usually does not.

name: Department of Patents, Designs and Trademarks (DPDT)
service: Trademark, patent and industrial design registration.
process: Application through DPDT, with published journals and opposition periods.
notes: Registering your brand name here is separate from clearing a company name at RJSC. Clearing one does not protect you on the other.

name: Copyright Office Bangladesh
service: Copyright registration for creative and software works.
notes: Copyright exists without registration, but registration gives you something to show in a dispute.

name: Bangladesh Standards and Testing Institution (BSTI)
service: Quality certification marks and standards compliance for regulated products.
process: Product testing and licence application through BSTI.
notes: Mandatory for a defined list of products, notably food and cosmetics. Check whether your specific product is on the list before budgeting for it.

name: Directorate General of Drug Administration (DGDA)
service: Licensing for medicines, dietary and herbal supplements, and related advertising approval.
process: Licence application under the DGDA citizen's charter; advertising and promotion need prior approval.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
applicationPath: Start at dgda.gov.bd and read the notices page for current circulars.
notes: Also governs supplements, which catches out sellers who assume only pharmaceuticals are regulated. Social media promotion without prior approval has been the subject of an explicit notice.

name: Fire Service and Civil Defence Directorate
process: Application and inspection under the Fire Prevention and Extinction Act 2003 and Rules 2014.
notes: Tied to the premises, not the company. Moving office means doing this again.

name: Bangladesh Bank
service: Foreign exchange approvals, inward and outward remittance rules, and share sale repatriation.
process: Most transactions run through your authorised dealer bank rather than the central bank directly.
applicationPath: Work through your authorised dealer bank; reference the Bangladesh Bank FE circulars.
notes: Matters the moment you take foreign investment or pay a foreign supplier. Get the rules right before the money moves, not after.
